To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the skin, lung, and gut can tolerate a second course of radiotherapy, but the dose should not exceed 50 Gy; (2) the spinal cord can tolerate a second dose of up to 30 Gy if the interval between the two courses is at least 1 year; and (3) the bladder and kidney cannot tolerate any reirradiation.
